subject: dm
title: Divisibility by three

solution.text: Let P(n) assert that 3 divides 4^n-1 for every integer n>=0. Basis: 4^0-1=0=3*0, so P(0) holds.
Inductive hypothesis: let k>=0 be arbitrary and assume 4^k-1=3*m for some integer m.
For P(k+1), 4^(k+1)-1=4*(4^k-1)+3. This exposes the hypothesis.
Substituting gives 4^(k+1)-1=4*(3*m)+3=3*(4*m+1). Let t=4*m+1; t is an integer, so P(k+1) holds.
By the principle of mathematical induction, 3 divides 4^n-1 for every integer n>=0.
